news.headline: UPS CEO Says Momentum In China To U.S. Trade Lanes Continued In Q3; International Business Returned To Y/Y Operating Profit Growth For First Time Since 2025 Us Trade Policy Changes; Healthcare Revenue Exceeded $3B For Third Consecutive Qtr, With Y/Y Growth In Every Segment; U.S. Consumers Remain Resilient, And The Outlook For Holiday Season Demand Is Strong; Q4 U.S. Average Daily Volume Expected To Be Lower Y/Y, Reflecting Delivery Actions We Took Earlier In The Year To Reduce Amazon Volume
United Parcel Service, Inc. Reports Q3 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: United Parcel Service, Inc. reported third-quarter 2026 adjusted earnings per share of $1.69 and revenue of $22.9 billion, both exceeding analyst expectations.

Boeing Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: The Boeing Company announced its financial results for the third quarter of 2026, reporting $24.2 billion in revenue and a GAAP loss per share of $0.26.
